'''Artok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who dwelt on the frozen ice [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]. He made his living on the world as a vendor and merchant, selling items and material to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] citizens. He wore a brown and blue uniform.

==Behind the scenes==
Artok first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' for Republic allied classes. In the game, he serves as a crew skills vendor.
